supports: Quote journey structure and visible form states
Qualified-demand outcome and CRM qualification definition

discovery_candidates.label: Quote request form
discovery_candidates.reason: The form is the principal visible entry into the qualified-demand journey.

journeys.name: Request a quote
journeys.outcome: Submit a quote request that can be assessed for qualification

objective_considerations.topic: Qualified demand generated by quote requests
objective_considerations.reason: The journey and business brief establish qualified demand as the intended value.

objective_considerations.topic: Conversion from quote interest to accepted request
objective_considerations.reason: The qualified-demand objective covers the applicable conversion stage.

objective_considerations.topic: Sales need for sufficiently qualified quote requests
objective_considerations.reason: The objective explicitly combines request generation and qualification quality.
Qualification and validation guardrails are included in the KPI system.

objectives.statement: Increase accepted quote demand without reducing request quality
objectives.rationale: The site prioritizes quote requests and the business brief identifies CRM qualification as the value-confirming outcome.

kpi_considerations.reason: Completion expresses the immediate digital outcome of quote demand.
Qualification separates valuable demand from raw submissions.
Higher completion should not be pursued while form usability degrades.
The outcome KPI directly measures journey completion.
The example has one material start-to-completion transition.
Observed validation failures are the material friction state.

kpis.name: Quote completion rate

formula.expression: accepted quote requests / started quote journeys
formula.grain: one result per quote journey identifier
formula.population: eligible public quote journeys started during the reporting window
inclusions: first accepted request per quote journey
exclusions: test traffic and duplicate retries after acceptance

components.name: Accepted quote requests
components.definition: Distinct quote journeys accepted by the quote service

components.name: Started quote journeys
components.definition: Distinct eligible quote journeys with first meaningful form progression

segmentation.rationale: Quote type changes user intent and the sales handling path.

kpis.decision_use: Identify whether acquisition and form changes improve accepted quote demand.

kpis.name: Qualified quote rate

formula.expression: qualified quote requests / accepted quote requests
formula.grain: one result per accepted quote request identifier
formula.population: accepted quote requests reaching a qualification decision
formula.reporting_window: calendar week with late qualification attributed to request week
inclusions: first final qualification decision per accepted request
exclusions: requests still awaiting qualification at the reporting cutoff

components.name: Qualified quote requests
components.definition: Accepted requests classified as qualified by the CRM rule

components.name: Accepted quote requests
components.definition: Distinct quote requests accepted by the quote service

segmentation.rationale: Qualification may vary materially by requested service.

kpis.decision_use: Adjust acquisition, eligibility, and sales handling when demand quality changes.

kpis.name: Quote validation error rate

formula.expression: quote journeys with a validation error / started quote journeys
formula.grain: one result per quote journey identifier
formula.population: eligible public quote journeys started during the reporting window
inclusions: journey counted once when any blocking validation error occurs
exclusions: non-blocking helper text and test traffic

components.name: Quote journeys with validation error
components.definition: Distinct started quote journeys with at least one blocking validation failure

components.name: Started quote journeys
components.definition: Distinct eligible quote journeys with first meaningful form progression

segmentation.rationale: Different quote forms may expose different validation friction.

kpis.decision_use: Detect form changes that increase friction while completion appears to improve.

dimensions.name: Quote type
dimensions.definition: The normalized service or project category selected for the quote request
dimensions.source_hint: Quote form and persisted CRM request category
dimensions.segmentation_purpose: Compare intent, form friction, and qualification across quote categories.

measurement_requirements.name: Quote journey started
measurement_requirements.semantic_fact: A distinct visitor makes the first meaningful progression in an eligible quote form.
measurement_requirements.timing_or_state: At the first valid progression beyond the initial empty form state; once per quote journey.
measurement_requirements.grain: one fact per quote journey identifier

measurement_requirements.name: Quote request accepted
measurement_requirements.semantic_fact: The quote service accepts a distinct request for downstream handling.
measurement_requirements.timing_or_state: After backend acceptance, not merely after a submit click.
measurement_requirements.grain: one fact per accepted quote request identifier

measurement_requirements.name: Quote request qualified
measurement_requirements.semantic_fact: An accepted quote request receives a final qualified classification under the approved CRM rule.
measurement_requirements.timing_or_state: At the first final CRM qualification decision, with attribution to the request cohort.
measurement_requirements.grain: one final fact per accepted quote request identifier

measurement_requirements.name: Blocking quote validation error
measurement_requirements.semantic_fact: A started quote journey encounters at least one validation failure that blocks progression.
measurement_requirements.timing_or_state: When a validation attempt blocks progression; deduplicate to journey-level incidence for the KPI.
measurement_requirements.grain: one or more raw facts per journey, reduced to one journey-level incidence

journey_completeness.rationale: Every material discovery candidate and journey state in the example scope is resolved.

journey_appropriateness.rationale: The journey has a distinct user intent, outcome, and material failure state.

objective_completeness.rationale: Value-stream, lifecycle, stakeholder, and risk lenses are resolved.

objective_appropriateness.rationale: The objective is locally evidenced, distinct, actionable, and explicitly marked as an inferred hypothesis.

kpi_completeness.rationale: Outcome, driver, guardrail, completion, step-conversion, and friction decisions are present.

kpi_appropriateness.rationale: Each KPI has a defined decision, owner, grain, population, formula, role, and relevant guardrail coverage.

requirement_traceability.rationale: Every formula component and dimension is linked bidirectionally to an explicit source and collection mode.

overall.rationale: The example framework is coverage-closed with no named exceptions.
